observations: Board correctly went 12 -> 10 active (2 pre-existing completed hidden) and dynamically 10 -> 9 -> 10 as a job is toggled.

Both pre-existing completed jobs in DB (0b9da08d, 6f06d631) belong to orphan client_ids (58a33398, 80b0bd5a) that no longer exist; navigating to /clientes/<deleted_id> redirects to /clientes with 'Cliente no encontrado' toast (existing behavior, unrelated to this change).

PUT /api/jobs/{id} requires the full payload (client_id + title mandatory) — passing only {status:'scheduled'} returns 422. Frontend's Select on /trabajos handles this correctly internally; only an explicit cURL/JS partial PATCH-like body would 422. Out of scope for this task but worth noting.
Completed-first sort is implemented in ClientDetail.js (lines 522-551) and verified visually with the marked job appearing at the top with 'Completed' badge.
Today's agenda hides completed jobs automatically because TasksPanel filters status!=='completed' — consistent with /trabajos board change.
critical_code_review_comments: Jobs.js: activeJobs = jobs.filter(j => j.status !== 'completed') is applied for grouping, header count, and empty state — correct and minimal change.

Jobs.js still keeps the 'Completed' option in the per-card status Select so users can archive a job; after the PUT mutation the local list re-filters and the card disappears on next load — UX is good.
ClientDetail.js: history-tab-trabajos is gated by hasBusiness so card-only users won't see business jobs (consistent with the rest of the business tabs).
ClientDetail.js sort: completed first then scheduled/created date desc — uses localeCompare on ISO date strings which is safe for YYYY-MM-DD.
Backend /clients/{id}/history.jobs still returns ALL jobs for the client (not filtered by status), which is required for this feature.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily marked job 38c91bad as 'completed' during testing and restored to 'scheduled' via PUT /api/jobs/{id} with full payload — environment left in original state (10 active jobs, 2 completed).
